AI is transforming how agencies source, engage, and place candidates. But between the hype and the reality, what actually works?
Recruit AI Live brings together five leading practitioners to share real-world insights, proven strategies, and honest lessons learned. No vendor pitches. No sponsored content. Just actionable knowledge you can implement the moment you get back to your desk.
CTA Button: Reserve Your Spot

What to Expect
An afternoon of focused learning and meaningful connections with fellow recruitment leaders from across Europe.
Five expert sessions from practitioners who've implemented AI in recruitment operations – covering sourcing, automation, candidate engagement, and business strategy.
Practical frameworks you can apply immediately, whether you're just exploring AI or already scaling it across your team.
Honest conversations about what works, what doesn't, and what's coming next – including compliance, ROI, and the human side of AI adoption.
Peer networking with forward-thinking agency owners and directors who share your challenges and ambitions.

Who Should Attend
Recruit AI Live is designed for recruitment agency professionals who make strategic decisions:

Agency owners and directors looking to future-proof their business
Senior recruiters and team leads ready to level up their skills
Operations managers exploring AI-powered efficiency gains
Anyone tired of generic AI hype and hungry for real-world applications

Whether you're running a boutique agency or leading a large recruitment team, you'll leave with concrete strategies tailored to agency life.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is Recruit AI Live?
Recruit AI Live is an independent conference focused on the practical application of AI in recruitment. Five expert speakers share real-world insights, proven strategies, and honest lessons learned – no vendor pitches, no sponsored content.
Who is this event for?
Agency owners, directors, team leads, and senior recruiters who want to understand how AI can improve their recruitment operations. Whether you're just starting to explore AI or already implementing it, you'll find valuable takeaways.
Why is the event in English?
Amsterdam has a large English-speaking recruitment community. Hosting the event in English ensures everyone can fully participate.
What's included in the ticket price?
Your ticket includes lunch, all five speaker sessions, coffee break, and networking opportunities. Everything you need for an afternoon of learning and connection.
Is there parking available?
Yes. Van der Valk Hotel Breukelen has free parking for all guests.
How do I get there by public transport?
The hotel is a 10-minute walk from Breukelen train station. Direct trains run from Amsterdam Centraal (25 min) and Utrecht Centraal (10 min).
Will the sessions be recorded?
No. Recruit AI Live is a live-only experience. This allows our speakers to share openly and encourages genuine conversation.
I'm a vendor – can I sponsor or exhibit?
Recruit AI Live is deliberately sponsor-free to guarantee unbiased content. We don't offer exhibition space or speaking slots in exchange for payment.
Can I get a refund if I can't attend?
Tickets are transferable to a colleague. Please contact us at least 7 days before the event to arrange a transfer. Refunds are available up to 14 days before the event.
I have dietary requirements – can you accommodate me?
Absolutely. Please let us know when you register and we'll make sure you're taken care of.
Will there be more Recruit AI Live events?
We're planning to make this a recurring event. Sign up for our mailing list to hear about future editions first.
I have another question – how can I reach you?
Email us at [email] and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.
